g.text: One ordinary court interface: support, air path and renewal
CONDITIONAL CONSTRUCTION COMPARISON. Geometry/flow screens are not installed ratings or assembly admission.
A CENTRAL YZ SECTION / north to right
5 mm bar: direct cap + PAN/carrier support.
4 removable keepers carry no walking load.
New front downfold WITHDRAWN.
Actual sill body 4110..4250 remains a source envelope.
New sill-carried nose 4095; top+15 / bottom−35.
Ordinary rear contact is UNRATED (dotted link).
Nose underflow ≈10.14 mm; no new full-width dam.
Bar 5.5 upper Z includes an UNPROVED 0.5 allowance.
Local cap/bearing/Services/thermal duties remain.
RC top−180; floor/DPC/door assembly cut must be tested.
B JAMB YZ ENVELOPE PROJECTION
Blue: retained tray 4090..4250 /75..150.
Bridge steps before 4085, then above 155.
Each necessary tray/PAN hard clearance 1 mm.
Frame airskin front 4108.5: north gap ≥2.5 mm.
No tray box is assumed empty; no water rating.
Folded angle support/boot/contacts remain unadmitted.
Caps south 15/up 100; then bar lifts 25 underneath.
Frame/boots + sill/nose remove before PAN north 500.
C FOUR REGISTERED CORNER THROATS
Lower planes X5142/6858; upper entry plane Y4030.
Lower: Y4025..4030 / Z5..10 (bar/notch).
Upper: full bridge 54+4 across X / Z75..80.
Two upper 58×9; two lower 9×9; separate 4 mm Z duty.
1206 mm²; ideal Cd = 1 flow 39.633 m³/h at 50 Pa.
Outer/root clamps must close; otherwise more paths exist.
D ONE SHARED OPENING-FAMILY ACCOUNT
Four corners: 1206.00 mm²
Two bar laps (0.5 conditional): 1780.00 mm²
Four keeper annuli: 62.83 mm²
Conditional ideal subtotal 100.195 m³/h.
ALL openings 158.087; remaining 57.892.
NO BUDGET PASS. Rear/cap/fixed joints, boots, all window/portal and three-door assemblies are unmeasured.
Bar flatness/bearing/movement allowance and slot bounds are development obligations, not observed performance.
Independent draught, insect, bulk-water, capillary, soil-gas, corrosion, thermal and actual renewal duties remain.
One 5 mm whole-sheet control £791.71 ex VAT is shared by bar/nose top; no installed-cost or material admission.
Source HAD 089f unchanged at reconciled b0d3102d; proposed accessories and shared test boundaries are explicit.
MAT-ENVELOPE stays open. No physical, architecture, material, air or water acceptance follows from this sheet.
